title: WCAG-Alpha-Contrast: reference implementation and crawler for alpha-aware WCAG contrast evaluation
description: JavaScript reference implementation of the extended WCAG contrast ratio pipeline, which resolves semi-transparent CSS colours (RGBA and HSLA) to their rendered opaque equivalents by Porter-Duff "over" compositing before computing relative luminance and contrast. The archive also contains the Playwright-based crawler, the analysis scripts and the raw data underlying the measurement study of the accompanying paper.
